newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin sees 4-wk T-bill auction on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin sees 4-wk T-bill auction on Thursday.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry expects to auction an eight billion crown tranche of four-week treasury bills on Thursday, the central bank (CNB) said in a preliminary statement on Tuesday.
The CNB statement did not give any further details of the auction, nor when it would officially decide on whether the operation would occur.
Average gross yield in an auction of a five billion crown tranche of four-week T-bills on August 13 dipped to 14.1 percent from 15.8 percent on July 23.
The limit yield on bids was set at 14.5 percent.
